summary:
## [1.1.10] - 2026-10-27

Release 1.1.10. Every link the admin hands out now names the server by localhost and by its LAN address. Zones become something the admin shapes and staff use in two taps: the placement editor renames,
colours and orders them, and a zone chip in the staff header now selects the whole area so a source tap sends to it.
The staff layout's widget editor reads as rows, the PIN keypad keeps the admin shortcut to itself and the shortcut
works there, Apple TV sources carry the Apple mark, the selected-TVs bar no longer collapses when the header is full,
and a fresh public releases repository no longer stops the online update channel from being published.

### Added

- **Every address the server answers on, wherever a link is handed out.** The setup checklist, the virtual audio
  controllers' links and QR, the Windows kiosk command and the System page's Server card now list `localhost` (for
  the server's own screen) and each LAN address the server reports (for panels, phones and other PCs), each with a
  Copy button, instead of whatever address the admin's browser happened to use. `GET /api/system/info` carries
  `port` and `addresses`.
- **Zones you can edit.** The placement editor's Zones panel (Admin › Floor plans) now renames a zone in place, picks
  its colour from six swatches, orders the zones with ▲ ▼ (the staff header's chips, the phone's Power and TVs tabs
  follow the order) and keeps a zone off the header's chip row with its **Chip** tick; Add and Delete as before.
  Settings › Staff screens › **Zone chips in the header** hides the row altogether. `ui.zoneChips`.

### Changed

- **Zone chips select the zone.** Tapping a zone chip in the staff header selects every TV in that zone (the
  selection bar comes up with the count, the rest of the plan dims) so a source tap sends to the whole zone: chip,
  then source. With a source already armed the chip sends it to the zone at once; a second tap on the chip clears the
  selection. **All** does the same for every TV on the plan. Before, a chip only dimmed the other TVs and renamed the
  bar's "+ zone" button.
- **Staff layout's widget editor reads at a glance.** The Top bar / Sidebar / Audio panel / Elsewhere lists are
  full-width rows (two columns on a wide screen) instead of four narrow columns: the widget's whole name, ▲ ▼ and
  the move buttons sit on one line.
- **Apple TV sources carry the Apple mark.** A white silhouette on the source's colour (the colour picker still
  tints the plate) instead of the "tv" wordmark, on markers, tiles, rows and the phone.
- **The staff PIN keypad no longer advertises the admin hotkey.** The line under the keypad reads "Ask a manager
  for the PIN."; the admin shortcut and the touch fallback still work there.
- **The video preview on the TV markers is easier to find.** It was always Settings › Staff screens › TV markers ›
  **Live picture on the markers** (plus **Live motion on the selected TVs**); the Preview page now says whether it is
  on with a button that jumps to the switch, the setup checklist's search finds it under "video preview", and how-to
  2 explains it.

### Fixed

- **The release channel can start from an empty public repository.** The Update manifest workflow created the
  release on the public releases repository before writing the channel file; on a repository without a commit GitHub
  answers 422 "Repository is empty" and the channel was neve
